description: Find feed generators without credentials, in one of two modes. query searches names and descriptions in the provider’s public feed catalog — not post text, and not every feed — through app.bsky.unspecced.getPopularFeedGenerators, an unstable upstream API that may change or become unavailable. actor lists every feed generator one account created, through app.bsky.feed.getActorFeeds. Pass exactly one. Both return feeds in provider order with generator AT-URIs, creator identities, and like counts; pass a feedUri to bsky_get_feed to read its posts. Continue with the returned opaque cursor and the same query or actor.

actor.description: Account whose feed generators to list: a handle (e.g. "bossett.social"), "@handle", DID, or the account’s bsky.app page. Pass query or actor, not both.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response. It continues only the mode and value it came from: pass it with the same query, or the same actor. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum feeds to return. Default 25; values above 100 are clamped with a notice unless read-limit clamping is disabled.

query.description: Feed catalog metadata to search, e.g. "science". Must not be blank. Pass query or actor, not both.

name: bsky_search_feeds

cap.description: The limit applied to this page.

cursor.description: Opaque next-page cursor. Its presence signals continuation even when feeds is empty; absent at the end.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_mode`: The arguments carry neither or both of query and actor. `actor_not_found`: Bluesky could not find the actor’s profile, or rejected the actor as an invalid identifier. `invalid_cursor`: The feed catalog returned its invalid-cursor response for a query request carrying a cursor. `catalog_unavailable`: The unstable upstream catalog endpoint behind query is no longer available (HTTP 404 or 410). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

feeds.description: Feeds on this page in provider order.

items.description: A feed generator from the catalog or from the actor’s own feeds.

creator.description: Identity of the account that created the feed.

did.description: Permanent DID of the feed creator.

description.description: Feed description supplied by its creator, when present.

displayName.description: Feed name supplied by its creator.

feedUri.description: Feed generator AT-URI; pass directly as feed to bsky_get_feed.

likeCount.description: Likes Bluesky counts for this feed; 0 is a real count. Absent when none was supplied.

notice.description: Continuation, empty-result, or clamping guidance. An empty actor page for a DID adds that Bluesky did not confirm the account exists when its profile check could not finish.

shown.description: Number of feeds returned on this page.

totalReturned.description: Number of feeds on this page.

truncated.description: True when a cursor is present, regardless of the number of feeds returned.

title: Search Bluesky Feeds
